claim: The xuixo is a deep-fried, sugar-coated cylindrical pastry filled with crema catalana that originated in 1920s Girona at Emili Puig's shop on Carrer Cort Reial.
quote: It is assumed that this viennoiserie originated in 1920s Girona in a shop owned by Emili Puig in the Street Cort Reial. ... It is a deep-fried, sugar-coated cylindrical product filled with crema catalana.

claim: Local legend credits the xuixo's name to el Tarlà, an acrobat who sneezed (xui-xui) while courting a pastry chef's daughter and promised the pastry's recipe.
quote: the invention of the Xuixo has to be credited to el Tarlà ... He sneezed (which sounds like xui-xui) and was discovered ... He named it after the sneeze that betrayed him.

claim: Mercat del Lleó is Girona's municipal market operating since 1944 at Plaça Calvet i Rubalcaba 15, with over 50 stalls and 150 professionals selling fresh meat, fish, charcuterie, produce, prepared dishes and wines, plus a bar for breakfast.
quote: El Mercat del Lleó és el mercat municipal de Girona. ... Des de 1944 ... més de 50 parades i 150 professionals ... un bar a on esmorzar-hi. ... Plaça Calvet i Rubalcaba, 15, 17002 – Girona

claim: Rocambolesc's flagship gelateria is at Carrer Santa Clara 50, 17001 Girona, selling soft ice cream plus chocolates, candies and confectionery, with a separate Bikineria at C/ de les Hortes 6.
quote: Gelateria: Carrer Sta. Clara 50, 17001 Girona ... soft ice cream, polo shirts, jars, and many other sweet preparations ... Bikineria: C/ de les Hortes número 6, 17001 Girona

claim: Rocambolesc is run by pastry chef Jordi Roca, the youngest of the Roca brothers behind El Celler de Can Roca, who uses the restaurant's dessert team to develop its gelato.
quote: Jordi Roca, the youngest brother and pastry chef, runs the ice cream shop's ... locations when he's not working at El Celler de Can Roca. ... Jordi utilizes the restaurant's dessert team to create rich, smooth, flavorful soft serve ice cream

claim: Empordà is the wine DO covering the northeast corner of Catalonia in Girona province, split into Alt Empordà and Baix Empordà subzones, with reds made mainly from Carinyena and Garnatxa and whites from Macabeu.
quote: Empordà is a Spanish Denominación de Origen Protegida ... in the province of Girona ... divided into two subzones: the northern Alt Empordà ... and the southern Baix Empordà ... red wines ... primarily made with the Carinyena and Garnatxa varieties

claim: Girona's best tapas include Basque-style pintxos venues such as Txalaka and Zanpanzar, with bars clustering around Plaça de la Independència and the Rambla de la Llibertat in the old town.
quote: Txalaka offers a trip to the Basque Country with an almost infinite variety of tapas and pintxos served on small slices of bread ... Zanpanzar offers authentic Basque cuisine with an impressive array of pintxos served on crusty bread

claim: Girona's Barri Vell old town has a dense bar scene including Sunset Jazz Club (speakeasy-style cocktails) and Vermuteria Lola for local vermouth and tapas.
quote: Sunset Jazz Club ... cosy, speakeasy-style joint ... impressive selection of spirits and cocktails. ... Vermuteria Lola ... where local vermouth and tapas come together ... The narrow, winding streets of the historic Barri Vell ... are brimming with bars

claim: Plaça de la Independència is a lively neoclassical arcaded square surrounded by tapas bars and restaurants, a central dining spot in Girona.
quote: Placa de la Independencia features a lively environment with good tapas bars and restaurants that surround the courtyard.
